Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green. ### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled) Triage first grade 6448388065, verbatim: "**p2:** a share link to any object other than `ai_conversations` renders `JSON.stringify(record)` in a `pre` block. Render the shared record read-only through the record renderer. The fields shown are exactly the fields the share read returns. ⛔ The client never widens them." No maintainer ruling. ### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome) On `origin/main` `912076f8`: - `ui/apps/console/src/pages/SharedRecordPage.tsx` (359 lines) resolves `GET {apiBase}/share-links/{token}/resolve` (≈L62). It branches at ≈L290 (`ai_conversations` renders the chat) and otherwise prints `
{JSON.stringify(data.record, null, 2)}
` (≈L345–346) above the "Some fields are hidden by the owner" line. - `ResolvedShare` (`shared-record-shape.ts` ≈L109) is `{ link, record, redactedFields? }`. It carries **no object schema**: no labels, no field types. The visitor may be anonymous or a different user. The open question is where labels and display types come from. Measure it in this order: 1. Can the page's visitor (signed out, and signed in without read on the object) read the object's metadata through a door that already exists for it? 2. If yes, render the record's own keys with that metadata's labels and the read-only field renderers (the record detail view's display path). Never add a field the record does not carry. 3. If not, render a read-only labelled list from what the payload has: a humanized key, and a value formatted by its JSON shape (date strings, booleans, numbers, arrays/objects as short text, never raw JSON). File the missing labels as a server-side out-of-scope finding (class a: "the share resolve payload carries no field labels/types"). State which branch you measured. ⛔ No server change in this card. - System fields: decide from what the payload carries. Do not hide or add keys by guess. If the record detail view has a shared "system field" notion you can reuse, use it and name it. Otherwise, show what came. ### Scope File surface: `SharedRecordPage.tsx`, `shared-record-shape.ts` only if a type is needed, one small new presentational component beside the page if that is cleaner, console i18n rows only if a label is needed (`sharedRecord.*`, both locales the console ships), and tests. Tests: a shared `account`-like record renders labelled read-only rows and no `
`/JSON; the `ai_conversations` branch is unchanged; `redactedFields` stay absent and the hidden-fields line still shows; a nested value renders as text, never `[object Object]`; zh labels where rows are added. Ablation: restore the `
` fallback, and the new test goes red. ⛔ The client never widens fields; ⛔ no change to the resolve request, its headers, or the password flow.

Serial: no open PR touches `SharedRecordPage.tsx` at the seat's read. Seat 2 holds the detail-view packages: consume them, ⛔ do not edit them.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate expected (run `dispatch-gates --tier` on your surface and quote it). `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected. Changeset per the console package's `private` flag (measure it).
